about: Dub's Vercel calls (dubinc/dub at 7e0101363b2a): its domain helpers with fetch to api.vercel.com and the env names Dub reads (VERCEL_API_KEY, TEAM_ID_VERCEL, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, EDGE_CONFIG_ID), and the unchanged @vercel/edge-config (Dub's ^0.4.1, locked 0.4.1) on the project's EDGE_CONFIG connection string, all issued by the World's credential door. The app writes its blocklists to Edge Config, checks a customer's domain against them in one getAll, adds the domain to the project (the apex's wildcard looked up first, as addDomainToVercel does), reads its configuration, and bans a phishing domain by reading the item with get and writing it back. The readback reads the project domain and the banned list back.
